Grade: Grade 3

Topic 1.5: Proper use and storage of 1.0 Health practices

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Proper use and storage of 1.0 Health practices. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Interpret simple instructions on dosage of simple instructions on dosage using medicine for various ailments,

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Proper use and storage of 1.0 Health practices.
2. Explain Proper use and storage of 1.0 Health practices to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Proper use and storage of 1.0 Health practices.
4. Show that you can: Interpret simple instructions on dosage of simple instructions on dosage using medicine for various ailments,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Proper use and storage of 1.0 Health practices. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Proper use and storage of 1.0 Health practices important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
